at://did:plc:ft5oehwo5qfqv5n2pzqlzstg/ap.text: Recently, I've been hooked on a new MS-DOS RPG called Penult. A port of a 2024 Atari 2600 RPG (yes, you read that right), this game is modeled heavily after the early Ultima games. With an easy interface, a balanced challenge, and a variety of fun characters, this game is a blast!
